Why almost half now hold some Christmas celebrations outside December

We are celebrating in November, January and even February

walesonline
  • Bookmark
  • Share
  • Comments
What's On
By
Neil ShawAssistant Editor
  • 12:56, 25 NOV 2026
  • Bookmark

    • Find things to do

    Get the latest Lancs Live breaking news on WhatsApp

    Our community members are treated to special offers, promotions and adverts from us and our partners. You can check out at any time. More info

    Join us on WhatsApp
    Listen to audio version of this article
    Sponsored by
    0:00 / 1:45
    Instaread

    People are redefining what family means this Christmas with festive celebrations spilling beyond December as people make time for their ‘chosen families’. More than one in three consider friends they’ve made as adults to be family, according to new research commissioned by Bella Italia.

    And as people make time to celebrate with both relatives and the friends they consider family, Christmas festivities are extending into November, January and even February. The study of 2,000 UK adults found that almost half have held a Christmas celebration outside of December because it was the only time everyone could make it.

    Friends made as adults and childhood friends top the list of people we consider family, followed by parents’ friends, friends’ parents, colleagues and neighbours.

    More than half expect their Christmas get-togethers to involve a home-cooked meal, while almost three in 10 plan to celebrate over a meal out at a restaurant or pub. Almost one in five enjoy an annual Christmas meal at a restaurant with people they’re not related to.

    Juliet Sugarman, brand director at Bella Italia, said: “Christmas is about making time for the people who make life special. From lifelong friends to neighbours and colleagues who have become like family, it's a time to reconnect, share stories and make memories around the table with the people we love, whether that’s the family we're born into or the family we choose.”

    This Christmas, Bella Italia is offering a festive menu featuring Christmas Carbonara and Camembert Pizza, Pigs in Blankets, Loaded Festive Fries and Mince Pie Cheesecake.
